newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal unemployment fell yr/yr 0.7 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Portugal unemployment fell yr/yr 0.7 pct in Feb.

text.p: The number of unemployed in Portugal fell a year-on-year 0.7 percent to 480,583 in February, the Employment Ministry said.

"The number of unemployed registered in the month in question compared with previous years shows that the rise in unemployment in Portugal has been contained which it had not been up until 1997," the ministry said in a statement.
It gave no overall figure for the unemployment rate.
The last official figure from the National Statistics Institute (INE) put unemployment in the fourth quarter of 1996 at 7.2 percent. -- Lisbon newsroom +(351-1) 3538254
